story.title: China's Moonshot AI raises $2B at $20B valuation as open-source AI demand drives $200M annual revenue
story.summary: Chinese AI lab Moonshot AI has closed a $2 billion funding round at a $20 billion valuation, reflecting surging global demand for open-source AI alternatives to US-based models. The company's annualised recurring revenue crossed $200 million in April 2026, driven by rapid growth in both paid consumer subscriptions and developer API usage. The raise positions Moonshot as one of China's highest-valued independent AI labs and underscores the commercial viability of open-weight model strategies.
